description: The data of a new work item.

workspace.description: The workspace slug, for example acme.

project.description: The project identifier, for example ENG. The room id of the event is <workspace>/<project>.

work_item_id.description: The Plane id of the work item.

identifier.description: The work item key, for example ENG-42.

name.description: The name of the work item.

url.description: The link to the work item in Plane. It is empty when the address is not known.

state.description: The name of the state of the work item, for example In Progress.

state_group.description: The state group: backlog, unstarted, started, completed, cancelled, or triage.

labels.description: The label names of the work item, in sorted order.

priority.description: The priority: urgent, high, medium, low, or none.

field.description: Empty for a new work item.
